name: 07920 · Basking Ridge, NJ
findings: ZIP 07920 (Basking Ridge) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07920 (Basking Ridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
